text: My daily routine is simple but well organised. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short break for lunch. Around six, I go to the gym or go running in the park, because exercise helps me relax after a busy day. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with my routine gives me energy and helps me feel balanced.
